Select IC50 activity rows for human C-C chemokine receptor type 5 (CHEMBL274). Return compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, literature reference (PubMed ID or DOI), assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join docs on activities.doc_id to get PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_structures to get canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL274 and standard_type IC50. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
